detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Infantry units’ ranged attacks have: [Assault]. While this unit is riled up, +3" R.

detachmentAbilities.name: Mob-handed Brutality
detachmentAbilities.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Boyz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]. If a friendly Orks Infantry unit made a charge move this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

datasheets.name: Big Mek In Mega Armour
datasheets.legend: For all that its weight is akin to wearing half a tank, mega armour is incredibly resilient. Big Meks often build and wear it, adding unstable kustom weaponry, force field projectors, crushing klaws or even tellyport blastas that kill victims by beaming their component parts across a wide area, much to the Orks’ amusement.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Kustom Shoota; 1 Power Klaw.

options.description: This model can be equipped with one of the following:1 Tellyport Blasta 1 Kustom Force Field
This model’s Kustom Shoota can be replaced with one of the following:1 Killsaw 1 Kombi-weapon 1 Kustom Mega-blasta

unitComposition.description: 1 Big Mek in Mega Armour model

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: LEADER24.22Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle. Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.
abilities.legend: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.description: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can: Re-roll advance rolls. Become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: That unit has 5+ InSv. That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

abilities.name: Fix Dat Armour Up (Once per battle, per unit)
abilities.description: In your Command phase, this unit heals 3 wounds. Place a Grot Oiler token next to the unit, removing it when this ability is used.

abilities.name: More Dakka
abilities.description: This unit’s ranged attacks have: [Ignores Cover]. If this unit is riled up, [Sustained Hits 1].

abilities.name: Kustom Force Field
abilities.description: This unit has 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit. EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes: Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. +1CPInto the Fray: When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
stratagems.legend: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked. EFFECT: Roll one D3: Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result. Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units). TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
stratagems.legend: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within. EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: CORNERED AND KRUMPED
stratagems.legend: It is no easy thing to disentangle from a mob of ferocious Orks and retreat in good order, especially when cornered by them within the claustrophobic confines of a voidship.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back. TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. EFFECT: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.

stratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
stratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That CHARACTER unit. EFFECT: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that model’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: NEVER ENOUGH DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: KUSTOM DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: MOB MENTALITY
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models. EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: BATTLEFIELD COMMAND
stratagems.legend: The commander's authoritative tone cuts through the din of battle, guiding the actions of nearby troops.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start or end of any phase. TARGET: One Leader unit from your army and one friendly Bodyguard unit within 6" of it that it could normally be attached to. EFFECT: Select one of your Leader unit’s Leader abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Bodyguard unit is treated as being led by that Leader unit for the purposes of that Leader ability. RESTRICTIONS: Once you target a unit with this Stratagem, that unit cannot be targeted with it again until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: LOOT ON THE MOVE
stratagems.legend: Not only does ripping a door hatch right off its hinges allow for ease of progress, but the resultant large slab of bulletproof metal can make a handy temporary shield.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: EAGER TO FIGHT
stratagems.legend: Impatient from being bottled up aboard their voidships with no one to clobber, this mob cannot wait to get stuck in to a proper scrap.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make an Advance move.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

enhancements.name: Ferocious Show-off
enhancements.legend: This brutal fighter is even more dangerous with a raucous audience of chanting Orks, as he displays his violent abilities as a warning to all.
enhancements.description: Orks Infantry model only. This model’s melee attacks have: +1 A. Or: If this unit has 11+ models, +2 A.

enhancements.name: Kunnin' But Brutal
enhancements.legend: Feigning weakness, this Ork allows his foes to think he’s legging it before suddenly piling back into the fight and delivering a brutal flurry of attacks.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Dreadherder
enhancements.legend: This Mek is deft at avoiding his creations’ feet and klaws.
enhancements.description: Big Mek model only. While this model is within 3" of a friendly Orks Walker unit (excluding BIG MEK units): This model has Lone Operative. In your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly ORKS WALKER unit within 3" of this model. That unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Follow Me Ladz
enhancements.legend: Always found at the forefront of an assault, this Ork likes to be the first into the fray with his mob close on his heels to join in the violence.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. This unit has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind
enhancements.legend: This Big Mek’s obsession with feverish inventing and his dreams of ludicrous technological destruction are infectious, inspiring other Orks to excitable aggression.
enhancements.description: Big Mek model only. This unit is riled up.

enhancements.name: Kaptin's Hat
enhancements.legend: This impressively ostentatious piece of headgear signifies that whoever nicked it last controls a fleet of kroozers and invasion landers, ideal for the rapid redeployment of loot-hungry Orks.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/Warboss Infantry model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Orks Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs
enhancements.legend: With a couple of these boggle-eyed varieties of Squigs on hand, even Ork shooting has a chance of hitting distant targets, helped by squinting really hard.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/bigBoss/Warboss model only. This unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Torrent] attacks) have +3" R.

enhancements.name: Supa-glowy Fing
enhancements.legend: The Mek who cobbled together this strange dakka accelerator isn’t sure exactly what it does - and it glows weirdly - but its new owner proudly carries it to battle, eager to know what its big switch will do this time.
enhancements.description: Orks Infantry model only (excluding Weirdboy models). This model’s ranged attacks have: [Anti-Infantry 4+]. [Devastating Wounds]. [SUPA-HAZARDOUS]. [SUPA-HAZARDOUS]: Each time a unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make two hazard rolls for that unit for each [SUPA-HAZARDOUS] weapon you selected in the Select Weapons step.

enhancements.name: Tellyporta Boss
enhancements.legend: This Ork has bullied his way into possession of a mostly functional tellyporta pad, and has so far survived being thrown through the Warp towards the best fights.
enhancements.description: Mega Armour model only. This unit (excluding Vehicle units) has Deep Strike.

enhancements.name: Kill Kommanda
enhancements.legend: Possessed of exceptional kunnin’ and a weird obsession with sneakin’ about, this powerful Ork leader loves nothing more than creeping through enemy defences before carving a bloody path through their lines.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/Warboss Infantry model only. While this model is part of an attached unit, this model has: Infiltrators. Stealth.

enhancements.name: Living Battering Ram
enhancements.legend: There is something uniquely terrifying to the foe about a nine-foot-tall, four-hundred-pound Ork who prefers to open hatchways with their head while running full tilt and bellowing like a battle tank.
enhancements.description: Each time the bearer attempts to operate a closed Hatchway, your opponent cannot try to prevent it. In addition, each time the bearer opens a Hatchway, each enemy unit within 6" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Cybork Boosta
enhancements.legend: This Mek’s extra bioniks help him keep up with his Kans.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/Mek model only. This model has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Scarred Brute
enhancements.legend: A veteran of many boarding actions, this monstrous Ork has been shot, stabbed and ejected into hard vacuum many times, and has all the toughened scarring and bionik wotnots to show for it.
enhancements.description: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Headwoppa's Killchoppa
enhancements.legend: Tribal legend speaks of a blood-slick choppa once owned by Grand Warboss Headwoppa - last seen charging headlong into a horde of daemons - that turns up occasionally across the galaxy in different forms. Though it looks normal, a dark voice is said to growl in the mind of the weapon’s wielder, driving them on to ever greater excesses of violence.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model’s melee attacks have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Da Boss is Watchin'
enhancements.legend: This war leader is a glowering incarnation of violence, his brutality so contagious that when he bellows his blind fury and releases his pent-up aggression, Orks nearby are excitedly swept along with him.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Movement phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

detachmentAbilities.name: Mob-handed Brutality
detachmentAbilities.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Boyz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]. If a friendly Orks Infantry unit made a charge move this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

detachmentAbilities.name: Unpredictable Genius
detachmentAbilities.legend: Meks haul all manner of weird bullets, unstable power cells and kustomised extras to battle.
detachmentAbilities.description: In your Shooting phase, when all of a friendly Big Mek/Mek Gunz/Morkanaut/Wazbom Blastajet unit’s ranged attacks target a single enemy unit, roll one D6: UNPREDICTABLE GENIUSD6RESULT1Dat’s Weird: The target unit has 4+ InSv until your unit has shot.2-3Hop Splat: Select one other enemy unit within 3" of the target. That unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.4Seekerz: Those attacks have +1 to hit rolls.5Lifted: The target unit has FLY, and cannot have the benefit of cover, until your unit has shot.6Runtified: The target unit has -1 T until your unit has shot.

detachmentAbilities.name: Belligerent Boarders
detachmentAbilities.legend: Between the excitement of smashing their way through the all-too-lootable interior of an enemy warship and their natural tendency to overlook their own mortal hurts - sometimes for hours at a time - Ork boarding parties can prove nightmarishly tough.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time an attack targets an ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that ORKS unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachmentAbilities.name: Comin’ Through
detachmentAbilities.legend: Very little can prevent a hulking Ork from smashing a path through a voidship’s decks to wherever he is trying to go. It is generally considered deeply unwise bordering on suicidal to try...
detachmentAbilities.description: In your Movement phase, Desperate Escape tests taken for ORKS models from your army are automatically passed and each time an ORKS unit from your army makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through other models as if they were not there, provided those other models have a lower Toughness characteristic than it.

detachmentAbilities.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
detachmentAbilities.legend: Always hunting for something to kill, when Orks spot a target they saturate it with dakka.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Infantry units’ ranged attacks have: [Assault]. While this unit is riled up, +3" R.

datasheets.name: Ghazghkull Thraka
datasheets.legend: To face Ghazghkull Thraka in battle is to die. Messily. He is a totemic war leader of great kunnin’ and terrifying presence who enjoys the personal protection of the Ork gods, not that he seems to need it! Makari bears aloft the personal Waaagh! banner of Ghazghkull. There isn’t a greenskin living who doesn’t fight harder in sight of that flag.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Adamantine ’Eadbutt; 1 Gork’s Klaw; 1 Mork’s Roar.

abilities.name: Da Boss
abilities.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.
abilities.legend: Whether capable of kunnin’ strategy or favouring something far less complicated, the biggest Ork tends to have a voice as aggressive and brutal as the rest of him. His bellows can be heard over the thickest fighting and his reputation ensures the ladz do as they’re told.

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.description: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can: Re-roll advance rolls. Become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: That unit has 5+ InSv. That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

abilities.name: Da Grand Warlord's Ladz
abilities.description: While this unit is within 3" of another friendly Orks Infantry unit, this unit has Lone Operative.

abilities.name: Makari, Hoist Dat Banner! (Once per battle, per army)
abilities.description: In your Movement phase, you can select a number of friendly ORKS units equal to or less than the current battle round number. Those units are riled up until the start of your next turn. Place one Makari token next to the unit, removing it after this ability is used.

abilities.name: Prophet of da Great Waaagh! (Aura)
abilities.description: While a friendly ORKS unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s melee attacks have: +1 to hit rolls. +1 to wound rolls.

abilities.name: SUPREME COMMANDER
abilities.description: If this model is in your army, it must be your WARLORD.

stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

EFFECT: Select one of your Leader unit’s Leader abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Bodyguard unit is treated as being led by that Leader unit for the purposes of that Leader ability. RESTRICTIONS: Once you target a unit with this Stratagem, that unit cannot be targeted with it again until your next Command phase.

stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.

stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: MOB MENTALITY
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models. EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: EAGER TO FIGHT
stratagems.legend: Impatient from being bottled up aboard their voidships with no one to clobber, this mob cannot wait to get stuck in to a proper scrap.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make an Advance move.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
stratagems.legend: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked. EFFECT: Roll one D3: Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result. Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units). TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: PIT FIGHTER
stratagems.legend: This Warboss is a terror of the fighting pits, single-mindedly battering his way through lesser foes or simply sweeping them aside as he carves a path towards his true quarry.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase. TARGET: One WARBOSS model from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.name: NEVER ENOUGH DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit. EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes: Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. +1CPInto the Fray: When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: KUSTOM DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: CORNERED AND KRUMPED
stratagems.legend: It is no easy thing to disentangle from a mob of ferocious Orks and retreat in good order, especially when cornered by them within the claustrophobic confines of a voidship.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back. TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. EFFECT: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
stratagems.legend: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within. EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: LOOT ON THE MOVE
stratagems.legend: Not only does ripping a door hatch right off its hinges allow for ease of progress, but the resultant large slab of bulletproof metal can make a handy temporary shield.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs
enhancements.legend: With a couple of these boggle-eyed varieties of Squigs on hand, even Ork shooting has a chance of hitting distant targets, helped by squinting really hard.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/bigBoss/Warboss model only. This unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Torrent] attacks) have +3" R.

detachmentAbilities.name: Mob-handed Brutality
detachmentAbilities.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Boyz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]. If a friendly Orks Infantry unit made a charge move this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

detachmentAbilities.name: Belligerent Boarders
detachmentAbilities.legend: Between the excitement of smashing their way through the all-too-lootable interior of an enemy warship and their natural tendency to overlook their own mortal hurts - sometimes for hours at a time - Ork boarding parties can prove nightmarishly tough.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time an attack targets an ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that ORKS unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

detachmentAbilities.name: Comin’ Through
detachmentAbilities.legend: Very little can prevent a hulking Ork from smashing a path through a voidship’s decks to wherever he is trying to go. It is generally considered deeply unwise bordering on suicidal to try...
detachmentAbilities.description: In your Movement phase, Desperate Escape tests taken for ORKS models from your army are automatically passed and each time an ORKS unit from your army makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through other models as if they were not there, provided those other models have a lower Toughness characteristic than it.

detachmentAbilities.name: ’Ard as Nails
detachmentAbilities.legend: The largest Orks have risen to their position through strength, savagery and being harder than anyone else.
detachmentAbilities.description: When a friendly Warboss model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to the roll if your unit is riled up: On a 3+, do not remove this WARBOSS model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this WARBOSS model is removed from the battlefield.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachmentAbilities.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
detachmentAbilities.legend: Always hunting for something to kill, when Orks spot a target they saturate it with dakka.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Infantry units’ ranged attacks have: [Assault]. While this unit is riled up, +3" R.

datasheets.name: Kaptin Badrukk
datasheets.legend: Kaptin Badrukk’s Goldtoof Armour is proof against anything the galaxy can throw at him. This is fortunate considering the levels of radiation that emanate from his pride and joy, Da Rippa. This kustom shoota fires unstable plasma shells that reduce Badrukk’s foes to glowing ash, at least until it malfunctions explosively.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Da Rippa; 1 Slugga.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: LEADER24.22Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle. Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.
abilities.legend: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.description: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can: Re-roll advance rolls. Become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: That unit has 5+ InSv. That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

datasheets.name: Boss Zagstruk
datasheets.legend: Plummeting from his kustom fighta-bommer at the head of his infamous Vulcha Boyz, Boss Zagstruk hits the enemy like a four hundred pound rocket-propelled missile of pure, belligerent fury. Amidst the roar of his blitz missiles and the crunch of bone beneath his cybork foot-klaws, bloody havoc ensues.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Da Vulcha's Klaws and Choppa; 1 Slugga.

abilities.legend: There are many ways by which to deploy troops to the field of battle including tunnels, teleportation devices and other esoteric means of transportation.

abilities.legend: The hardiest warriors refuse to be laid low, even by wounds that should by all rights prove lethal.

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.description: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can: Re-roll advance rolls. Become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: That unit has 5+ InSv. That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

abilities.name: Drill Boss
abilities.description: This unit’s melee attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Plummeting Descent
abilities.description: If this unit made an ingress move this turn, this unit can re-roll charge rolls.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit. EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes: Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. +1CPInto the Fray: When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

stratagems.name: MOB MENTALITY
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models. EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.name: BATTLEFIELD COMMAND
stratagems.legend: The commander's authoritative tone cuts through the din of battle, guiding the actions of nearby troops.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start or end of any phase. TARGET: One Leader unit from your army and one friendly Bodyguard unit within 6" of it that it could normally be attached to. EFFECT: Select one of your Leader unit’s Leader abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Bodyguard unit is treated as being led by that Leader unit for the purposes of that Leader ability. RESTRICTIONS: Once you target a unit with this Stratagem, that unit cannot be targeted with it again until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units). TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
stratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That CHARACTER unit. EFFECT: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that model’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
stratagems.legend: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked. EFFECT: Roll one D3: Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result. Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: NEVER ENOUGH DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: KUSTOM DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
stratagems.legend: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within. EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachmentAbilities.name: Mob-handed Brutality
detachmentAbilities.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Boyz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]. If a friendly Orks Infantry unit made a charge move this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

detachmentAbilities.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
detachmentAbilities.legend: Always hunting for something to kill, when Orks spot a target they saturate it with dakka.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Infantry units’ ranged attacks have: [Assault]. While this unit is riled up, +3" R.

datasheets.name: Boss Snikrot
datasheets.legend: Boss Snikrot is a murderous ghost whose obsession with kommando warfare has seen him transcend the cunning of his fellow Blood Axes and achieve instead something nigh supernatural. By the time his terrified foes realise he is upon them, the Boss is already opening their throats with his rip-toothed blades.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Mork’s Teef; 1 Slugga.

abilities.name: Infiltrators
abilities.description: INFILTRATORS24.20Many armies employ reconnaissance units who can sit concealed, waiting for the right moment to strike. During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.
abilities.legend: Many armies employ reconnaissance units who can sit concealed, waiting for the right moment to strike.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: LEADER24.22Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle. Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.
abilities.legend: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.

abilities.name: Lone Operative
abilities.description: LONE OPERATIVE24.24Assassins and other covert agents are difficult to pinpoint in the storm of battle. Unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. If this ability takes the form Lone Operative X", unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within X" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within X" of this unit.
abilities.legend: Assassins and other covert agents are difficult to pinpoint in the storm of battle.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.description: STEALTH24.33The stealthiest warriors can evade the attentions, and the bullets, of their foes. If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).
