stratagems.legend: Not only does ripping a door hatch right off its hinges allow for ease of progress, but the resultant large slab of bulletproof metal can make a handy temporary shield.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

stratagems.name: MOB MENTALITY
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models. EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVES
stratagems.legend: Priming grenades or other explosives, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not make an advance move this turn. EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence: Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit. Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Tellyporta
enhancements.legend: Employing madcap tellyporta arrays, Ork Meks can beam massively armoured Nobz through the warp and onto an enemy vessel, much to the horror of the defenders.
enhancements.description: In the Deploy Armies step, select one MEGANObz unit from your army. Until the end of the battle, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

detachmentAbilities.name: Displays of Savagery
detachmentAbilities.legend: Nobz have a position of dominance to maintain, and do so in vicious eruptions of violence.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Meganobz/Nobz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachmentAbilities.name: Comin’ Through
detachmentAbilities.legend: Very little can prevent a hulking Ork from smashing a path through a voidship’s decks to wherever he is trying to go. It is generally considered deeply unwise bordering on suicidal to try...
detachmentAbilities.description: In your Movement phase, Desperate Escape tests taken for ORKS models from your army are automatically passed and each time an ORKS unit from your army makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through other models as if they were not there, provided those other models have a lower Toughness characteristic than it.

detachmentAbilities.name: Mob-handed Brutality
detachmentAbilities.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Boyz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]. If a friendly Orks Infantry unit made a charge move this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachmentAbilities.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
detachmentAbilities.legend: Always hunting for something to kill, when Orks spot a target they saturate it with dakka.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Infantry units’ ranged attacks have: [Assault]. While this unit is riled up, +3" R.

datasheets.name: Kommandos
datasheets.legend: No right-thinking Ork trusts Kommandos. They sneak up on the enemy rather than charging in headlong, and have an unhealthy fascination with very big knives and their application to people’s backs, throats and guts. That said, having a band of Kommandos ambush the enemy mid-battle definitely has its uses.
datasheets.loadout: Every model is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Slugga.

options.description: The Nob can have their Choppa replaced with one of the following:1 Big Choppa 1 Power Klaw
1 Kommando model can be equipped with 1 Burna.
1 Kommando model can be equipped with 1 Rokkit Launcha.
1 Kommando model can have their Choppa replaced with 1 Breacha Ram.
Up to 2 Kommando models can each be equipped with 1 Kustom Shoota.

abilities.name: Infiltrators
abilities.description: INFILTRATORS24.20Many armies employ reconnaissance units who can sit concealed, waiting for the right moment to strike. During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.
abilities.legend: Many armies employ reconnaissance units who can sit concealed, waiting for the right moment to strike.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.description: STEALTH24.33The stealthiest warriors can evade the attentions, and the bullets, of their foes. If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).
abilities.legend: The stealthiest warriors can evade the attentions, and the bullets, of their foes.

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.description: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can: Re-roll advance rolls. Become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: That unit has 5+ InSv. That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

abilities.name: Found ’Em!
abilities.description: In your Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That unit has +3" detection range until the end of the turn. Place one Kommando Grot token next to that enemy unit to remind you.

abilities.name: Taktikal Know-wotz
abilities.description: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can split this unit into two units, each with a starting strength of 5. If you do, select which one of those units will have the Bomb Squig ability and which one of those units will have the Found ’Em! ability.

abilities.name: Nowhere to Hide
abilities.description: This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Bomb Squig (Once per battle, per unit)
abilities.description: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal move, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit and roll one D6: On a 3+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Place one Bomb Squig token next to the unit, removing it after this ability is used.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
stratagems.legend: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked. EFFECT: Roll one D3: Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result. Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units). TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
stratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase. TARGET: One friendly SMOKE unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

stratagems.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: WHILE THEIR BACKS ARE TURNED
stratagems.legend: With the gitz they were fighting having scarpered, mobs with a plan exploit the sudden lull to press towards whatever target has next caught their eye.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit that was engaged at the start of the phase. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVES
stratagems.legend: Priming grenades or other explosives, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not make an advance move this turn. EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence: Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit. Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

stratagems.name: MIND MOSTLY ON THE MISSION
stratagems.legend: When there’s a dirty job needs doing, Orks with strange compulsions get a kick out of causing such trouble sneakily or swiftly.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move. TARGET: That BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit. EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
stratagems.legend: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within. EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: DUBIOUS RESTRAINT
stratagems.legend: A few Orks, particularly those of a rebelliously disciplined outlook, can resist their destructive urges just long enough to prioritise strategic gains.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start/end of your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit. EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

stratagems.name: NEVER ENOUGH DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: EAGER TO FIGHT
stratagems.legend: Impatient from being bottled up aboard their voidships with no one to clobber, this mob cannot wait to get stuck in to a proper scrap.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make an Advance move.

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: KUSTOM DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit. EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes: Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. +1CPInto the Fray: When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: MOB MENTALITY
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models. EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

enhancements.name: Throat-slittas
enhancements.legend: Veterans of the relatively organised butchery of well-protected targets, these distrusted Orks make excellent forward assassins.
enhancements.description: Kommandos/Stormboyz unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

detachmentAbilities.name: Mob-handed Brutality
detachmentAbilities.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Boyz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]. If a friendly Orks Infantry unit made a charge move this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

detachmentAbilities.name: Belligerent Boarders
detachmentAbilities.legend: Between the excitement of smashing their way through the all-too-lootable interior of an enemy warship and their natural tendency to overlook their own mortal hurts - sometimes for hours at a time - Ork boarding parties can prove nightmarishly tough.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time an attack targets an ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that ORKS unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachmentAbilities.legend: Always hunting for something to kill, when Orks spot a target they saturate it with dakka.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Infantry units’ ranged attacks have: [Assault]. While this unit is riled up, +3" R.

detachmentAbilities.name: Suspiciously Well Organised
detachmentAbilities.legend: An un-Orky compulsion for discipline can wrongfoot enemies expecting anarchic disorder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Stormboyz units have BATTLELINE. When a friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

datasheets.name: Trukk
datasheets.legend: Trukks are ramshackle assemblages of hastily welded and riveted scrap metal bolted to overpowered engine blocks and rusty chassis. Rolling on fat, armoured tyres, they bear mobs of Orks into battle at high speed, shrugging off enemy fire by the simple expedient of shedding ablative panels and plates.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Dual Big Shoota; 1 Spiked Ram.
datasheets.transport: This model has a transport capacity of 12 Orks Infantry models. It cannot transport Ghazghkull Thraka/Jump Pack models. Each Mega Armour model takes up the space of 2 models.

options.description: This model’s Dual Big Shoota can be replaced with 1 Rokkit Launcha.
This model can be equipped with one of the following:1 Buzzsaw 1 Grabbin' Klaw

abilities.name: Deadly Demise
abilities.description: DEADLY DEMISE24.08From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat. This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").
abilities.legend: From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.

abilities.name: Firing Deck
abilities.description: FIRING DECK24.14Some transports have dedicated platforms or firing ports from which embarked passengers can lay down a withering hail of munitions. This ability always takes the form Firing Deck X. In your Shooting phase, each time this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, if one or more units are embarked within it, resolve the following sequence: Select up to X models embarked within this TRANSPORT (excluding models whose units have already been selected to shoot this phase). For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons). Until this TRANSPORT has resolved all of its attacks, it has all of those selected weapons in addition to its other weapons. Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this TRANSPORT are not eligible to shoot.
abilities.legend: Some transports have dedicated platforms or firing ports from which embarked passengers can lay down a withering hail of munitions.

abilities.name: Pilin’ Out
abilities.description: In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this model, units embarked within this model can make a disembark move using the rapid disembark mode.

stratagems.name: DRIVE-BY BUSTIN'
stratagems.legend: Ork transports are not the smoothest of rides. However, the best loot-hunters have honed their drive-by volleys of armour-cracking firepower to the point of deadly accuracy.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Transport unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS TRANSPORT unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.

stratagems.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
stratagems.legend: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Speed Freeks unit. TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.

stratagems.name: MOW 'EM DOWN
stratagems.legend: Spiked rams, deff rollas and glyph-heavy dozer blades are more than just stylish statements for the crew of Ork vehicles.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Orks Vehicle unit (excluding Walker units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have: [Cleave 1]. Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
stratagems.legend: In extremis, armoured vehicles and rampaging monsters can use their sheer size as a weapon, ramming and crushing enemies beneath their colossal bulk, though doing so risks sustaining damage in return.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move. TARGET: That MONSTER/VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Select one model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: FUNGUS-FUEL INJECTION
stratagems.legend: Fermented through entirely unstable processes, just a drop of these potent additives can supercharge any Mek-built engine.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Orks mounted/vehicle unit is selected to move. TARGET: That ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit has +2" M.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units). TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: DAKKASTORM
stratagems.legend: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz
enhancements.legend: These loud, fume-belching devices wreathe those in the Speed Freeks’ wake in a thick bank of obscuring smoke.
enhancements.description: Speed Freeks unit only (excluding Aircraft units). When an attack targets a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of a model in this unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

detachmentAbilities.name: Adrenaline Junkies
detachmentAbilities.legend: After smashing into the foe at full tilt, a Speed Freek will pull hairpin turns to do it all again.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Warbikers units have BATTLELINE. When a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move: That unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault] until the end of the turn. That move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

datasheets.name: Stormboyz
datasheets.legend: Most Orks mock Stormboyz for their acts of juvenile rebellion, from taking orders and shining their boots to marching about, talking about ‘taktics’ and even following a battle plan. Yet when that plan is ‘strap on a high powered rokkit and hurtle into the enemy bellowing “Waaagh!”’, it does prove to have its merits.
datasheets.loadout: The Nob is equipped with: 1 Kustom Choppa; 1 Slugga. Every Stormboy is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Slugga.

options.description: The Nob can have their Kustom Choppa replaced with 1 Power Klaw.

abilities.name: Deep Strike
abilities.description: DEEP STRIKE24.09There are many ways by which to deploy troops to the field of battle including tunnels, teleportation devices and other esoteric means of transportation. Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.
abilities.legend: There are many ways by which to deploy troops to the field of battle including tunnels, teleportation devices and other esoteric means of transportation.

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.description: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can: Re-roll advance rolls. Become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: That unit has 5+ InSv. That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

abilities.name: Rokkit Charge
abilities.description: When this unit is selected to fight, if this unit made a charge move this turn, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit’s melee attacks have: +1 A and S. [Hazardous].

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: EAGER TO FIGHT
stratagems.legend: Impatient from being bottled up aboard their voidships with no one to clobber, this mob cannot wait to get stuck in to a proper scrap.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make an Advance move.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.

EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit. EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes: Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. +1CPInto the Fray: When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: MIND MOSTLY ON THE MISSION
stratagems.legend: When there’s a dirty job needs doing, Orks with strange compulsions get a kick out of causing such trouble sneakily or swiftly.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move. TARGET: That BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit. EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

stratagems.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
stratagems.legend: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked. EFFECT: Roll one D3: Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result. Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: NEVER ENOUGH DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVES
stratagems.legend: Priming grenades or other explosives, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not make an advance move this turn. EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence: Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit. Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

stratagems.name: DUBIOUS RESTRAINT
stratagems.legend: A few Orks, particularly those of a rebelliously disciplined outlook, can resist their destructive urges just long enough to prioritise strategic gains.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start/end of your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit. EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: WHILE THEIR BACKS ARE TURNED
stratagems.legend: With the gitz they were fighting having scarpered, mobs with a plan exploit the sudden lull to press towards whatever target has next caught their eye.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit that was engaged at the start of the phase. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: KUSTOM DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: MOB MENTALITY
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models. EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
stratagems.legend: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within. EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

enhancements.name: Throat-slittas
enhancements.legend: Veterans of the relatively organised butchery of well-protected targets, these distrusted Orks make excellent forward assassins.
enhancements.description: Kommandos/Stormboyz unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

detachmentAbilities.name: Mob-handed Brutality
detachmentAbilities.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Boyz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]. If a friendly Orks Infantry unit made a charge move this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

detachmentAbilities.name: Suspiciously Well Organised
detachmentAbilities.legend: An un-Orky compulsion for discipline can wrongfoot enemies expecting anarchic disorder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Stormboyz units have BATTLELINE. When a friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

detachmentAbilities.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
detachmentAbilities.legend: Always hunting for something to kill, when Orks spot a target they saturate it with dakka.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Infantry units’ ranged attacks have: [Assault]. While this unit is riled up, +3" R.

detachmentAbilities.name: Belligerent Boarders
detachmentAbilities.legend: Between the excitement of smashing their way through the all-too-lootable interior of an enemy warship and their natural tendency to overlook their own mortal hurts - sometimes for hours at a time - Ork boarding parties can prove nightmarishly tough.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time an attack targets an ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that ORKS unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

datasheets.name: Deffkoptas
datasheets.legend: Most Orks take a dim view of muckin’ about in the sky, and would much rather go to war with their feet firmly on the ground. Deffkopta pilots are the lunatic exception, hurtling ahead to spy out enemy forces for their warband to bring to battle, and to give those same enemies a good strafing run or three in the meantime.
datasheets.loadout: Every model is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Rokkit Launcha; 1 Slugga; 1 Spinnin’ Blades.

options.description: For every 3 models in this unit, 1 model can have their Rokkit Launcha replaced with 1 Kustom Mega-blasta.

stratagems.name: WHIRLIGIG EVASION
stratagems.legend: Enemy attempts to hunt Deffkoptas down can be stymied by nimble aerial evasion, usually accompanied by a crude hand gesture in the foe’s direction.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Deffkoptas unit within 8" of that enemy unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If your unit is riled up, up to 6".

stratagems.name: LONG, UNCONTROLLED BURSTS
stratagems.legend: Ork Flyboyz will fill the skies with dakka in an attempt to down any enemy they think is muscling in on their aerial turf.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit. EFFECT: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.legend: Fermented through entirely unstable processes, just a drop of these potent additives can supercharge any Mek-built engine.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Orks mounted/vehicle unit is selected to move. TARGET: That ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit has +2" M.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units). EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
stratagems.legend: In extremis, armoured vehicles and rampaging monsters can use their sheer size as a weapon, ramming and crushing enemies beneath their colossal bulk, though doing so risks sustaining damage in return.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move. TARGET: That MONSTER/VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Select one model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
stratagems.legend: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Speed Freeks unit. TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model: Advance roll Charge roll Damage roll Hazard roll Hit roll Save roll Wound roll A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon. TARGET: That unit or model. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVES
stratagems.legend: Priming grenades or other explosives, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not make an advance move this turn. EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence: Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit. Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: DAKKASTORM
stratagems.legend: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz
enhancements.legend: These loud, fume-belching devices wreathe those in the Speed Freeks’ wake in a thick bank of obscuring smoke.
enhancements.description: Speed Freeks unit only (excluding Aircraft units). When an attack targets a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of a model in this unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

detachmentAbilities.name: Adrenaline Junkies
detachmentAbilities.legend: After smashing into the foe at full tilt, a Speed Freek will pull hairpin turns to do it all again.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Warbikers units have BATTLELINE. detachmentAbilities.name: Skyborne Loons
detachmentAbilities.legend: When attacking en masse, crazed and excitable Flyboyz unleash torrential quantities of dakka.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Aircraft units do not count towards the combined points value of your strategic reserves units. While a friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit is riled up, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

datasheets.name: Dakkajet
datasheets.legend: Rocketing through the skies on billowing trails of flame and smoke, Dakkajets come in low and hard over the battlefield. These single-seater Ork attack craft are ludicrously over-gunned for their size, all but shaking themselves apart as their pilots unleash storms of dakka on luckless ground targets or enemy aircraft with equal glee.

stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought. TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase. EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVE CLEARANCE
stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
stratagems.legend: In extremis, armoured vehicles and rampaging monsters can use their sheer size as a weapon, ramming and crushing enemies beneath their colossal bulk, though doing so risks sustaining damage in return.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move. TARGET: That MONSTER/VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Select one model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: DAKKASTORM
stratagems.legend: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT). EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04). RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

enhancements.name: Flyboss
enhancements.legend: Brutish aces who have survived enough dogfights to rise to positions of superiority, Flybosses inspire other Ork aviators to heights of psychotic enthusiasm.
enhancements.description: Orks Aircraft unit only. This unit has CHARACTER. When this unit ends an ingress move, each friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit within 6" of this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon
enhancements.legend: Despite claims of scoutin’, this aircraft’s screaming dive ahead of its pilot’s mates is purely for the thrill of attacking first.
enhancements.description: Orks Aircraft unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachmentAbilities.name: Adrenaline Junkies
detachmentAbilities.legend: After smashing into the foe at full tilt, a Speed Freek will pull hairpin turns to do it all again.

detachmentAbilities.name: Skyborne Loons
detachmentAbilities.legend: When attacking en masse, crazed and excitable Flyboyz unleash torrential quantities of dakka.

datasheets.legend: While not as shooty as a Dakkajet, each Blitza-bommer lugs enormous boom bombs into battle under its wings. Dive-bombing the enemy with reckless abandon, the Blitza-bommers detach their oversized payloads before (hopefully) pulling up and screaming skywards again while vast fireballs billow in their wake.

abilities.name: Damaged
abilities.description: DAMAGED24.39This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model’s remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged: while damaged, that model’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise
abilities.description: DEADLY DEMISE24.08From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat. This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").
abilities.legend: From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.

abilities.name: Waaagh!

abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

abilities.name: Boom Bomb
abilities.description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, select one visible enemy unit (excluding Lone Operative units) within 24" of this unit, and roll one D6 for that unit: On a 1-3, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. On a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. On a 6, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.

When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks. TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just after you have failed a Battle-shock test taken for a unit from your army. TARGET: The unit from your army that Battle-shock test was just taken for (even though your Battle-shocked units cannot normally be affected by your Stratagems). EFFECT: Your unit is treated as having passed that test instead, and is not Battle-shocked as a result.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: FUNGUS-FUEL INJECTION
stratagems.legend: Fermented through entirely unstable processes, just a drop of these potent additives can supercharge any Mek-built engine.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Orks mounted/vehicle unit is selected to move. TARGET: That ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit has +2" M.

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: LONG, UNCONTROLLED BURSTS
stratagems.legend: Ork Flyboyz will fill the skies with dakka in an attempt to down any enemy they think is muscling in on their aerial turf.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit. EFFECT: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Flyboss
enhancements.legend: Brutish aces who have survived enough dogfights to rise to positions of superiority, Flybosses inspire other Ork aviators to heights of psychotic enthusiasm.
enhancements.description: Orks Aircraft unit only. This unit has CHARACTER. When this unit ends an ingress move, each friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit within 6" of this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon
enhancements.legend: Despite claims of scoutin’, this aircraft’s screaming dive ahead of its pilot’s mates is purely for the thrill of attacking first.
enhancements.description: Orks Aircraft unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

detachmentAbilities.name: Adrenaline Junkies
detachmentAbilities.legend: After smashing into the foe at full tilt, a Speed Freek will pull hairpin turns to do it all again.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Warbikers units have BATTLELINE. When a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move: That unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault] until the end of the turn. That move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

detachmentAbilities.name: Unpredictable Genius
detachmentAbilities.legend: Meks haul all manner of weird bullets, unstable power cells and kustomised extras to battle.
detachmentAbilities.description: In your Shooting phase, when all of a friendly Big Mek/Mek Gunz/Morkanaut/Wazbom Blastajet unit’s ranged attacks target a single enemy unit, roll one D6: UNPREDICTABLE GENIUSD6RESULT1Dat’s Weird: The target unit has 4+ InSv until your unit has shot.2-3Hop Splat: Select one other enemy unit within 3" of the target. That unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.4Seekerz: Those attacks have +1 to hit rolls.5Lifted: The target unit has FLY, and cannot have the benefit of cover, until your unit has shot.6Runtified: The target unit has -1 T until your unit has shot.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachmentAbilities.name: Skyborne Loons
detachmentAbilities.legend: When attacking en masse, crazed and excitable Flyboyz unleash torrential quantities of dakka.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Aircraft units do not count towards the combined points value of your strategic reserves units. While a friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit is riled up, this unit’s ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

datasheets.name: Warbikers
datasheets.legend: Ork Warbikers race into battle with dakkaguns hammering, ragged trails of dust and smoke boiling up behind them like an ill omen. They race one another at breakneck pace to reach the enemy first, execute death-defying stunts at suicidal speeds, then crash headlong into the foe’s battle line like battering rams.
datasheets.loadout: The Biker Nob is equipped with: 1 Kustom Choppa; 1 Dual Kombi-rokkit. Every Warbiker is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Dual Dakkagun.

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.description: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can: Re-roll advance rolls. Become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: That unit has 5+ InSv. That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

abilities.name: High-speed Carnage
abilities.description: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit’s melee attacks have: +1 S and D.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after you have made a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll, a saving throw, an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test, a Hazardous test, or just after you have rolled the dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon, for an attack, model or unit from your army. TARGET: That unit or model from your army. EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit. EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes: Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. +1CPInto the Fray: When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6. When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.legend: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.

stratagems.legend: A well-placed explosive munition in confined shipboard spaces can cause bloody carnage.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Select one model in your unit that is equipped with a weapon with the [BLAST] ability. Until the end of the phase, when determining how many models are in the target unit for the purpose of that ability, include models that are not visible to the attacking model. In addition, attacks made with that weapon can be allocated to models that are not visible to the attacking model.

stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVES
stratagems.legend: Priming grenades or other explosives, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not make an advance move this turn. EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence: Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit. Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

options.description: Any number of models can each have their Smasha Gun replaced with one of the following:1 Bubblechukka 1 Kustom Mega-kannon 1 Traktor Kannon
