That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

abilities.name: Intimidating Motivation (Once per battle round, per army)
abilities.description: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ORKS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit: Is no longer battle-shocked. Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Nazdreg’s Know-wotz
abilities.description: This unit has Deep Strike. This unit’s ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

abilities.name: Supreme Kunnin’ (Once per phase, per army)
abilities.description: In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can: Make a normal move of up to D6". Or: If this unit is riled up, make a normal move of up to 5".

stratagems.name: MOB MENTALITY
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models. EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
stratagems.legend: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked. EFFECT: Roll one D3: Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result. Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units). TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: KUSTOM DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: PIT FIGHTER
stratagems.legend: This Warboss is a terror of the fighting pits, single-mindedly battering his way through lesser foes or simply sweeping them aside as he carves a path towards his true quarry.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase. TARGET: One WARBOSS model from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
stratagems.legend: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within. EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: LOOT ON THE MOVE
stratagems.legend: Not only does ripping a door hatch right off its hinges allow for ease of progress, but the resultant large slab of bulletproof metal can make a handy temporary shield.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: CORNERED AND KRUMPED
stratagems.legend: It is no easy thing to disentangle from a mob of ferocious Orks and retreat in good order, especially when cornered by them within the claustrophobic confines of a voidship.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back. TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. EFFECT: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: NEVER ENOUGH DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: EAGER TO FIGHT
stratagems.legend: Impatient from being bottled up aboard their voidships with no one to clobber, this mob cannot wait to get stuck in to a proper scrap.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make an Advance move.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs
enhancements.legend: With a couple of these boggle-eyed varieties of Squigs on hand, even Ork shooting has a chance of hitting distant targets, helped by squinting really hard.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/bigBoss/Warboss model only. This unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Torrent] attacks) have +3" R.

detachmentAbilities.name: Comin’ Through
detachmentAbilities.legend: Very little can prevent a hulking Ork from smashing a path through a voidship’s decks to wherever he is trying to go. It is generally considered deeply unwise bordering on suicidal to try...
detachmentAbilities.description: In your Movement phase, Desperate Escape tests taken for ORKS models from your army are automatically passed and each time an ORKS unit from your army makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through other models as if they were not there, provided those other models have a lower Toughness characteristic than it.

detachmentAbilities.name: ’Ard as Nails
detachmentAbilities.legend: The largest Orks have risen to their position through strength, savagery and being harder than anyone else.
detachmentAbilities.description: When a friendly Warboss model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to the roll if your unit is riled up: On a 3+, do not remove this WARBOSS model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this WARBOSS model is removed from the battlefield.

detachmentAbilities.name: Mob-handed Brutality
detachmentAbilities.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Boyz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]. If a friendly Orks Infantry unit made a charge move this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachmentAbilities.name: Belligerent Boarders
detachmentAbilities.legend: Between the excitement of smashing their way through the all-too-lootable interior of an enemy warship and their natural tendency to overlook their own mortal hurts - sometimes for hours at a time - Ork boarding parties can prove nightmarishly tough.
detachmentAbilities.description: Each time an attack targets an ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that ORKS unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

detachmentAbilities.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
detachmentAbilities.legend: Always hunting for something to kill, when Orks spot a target they saturate it with dakka.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Orks Infantry units’ ranged attacks have: [Assault]. While this unit is riled up, +3" R.

datasheets.name: Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies
datasheets.loadout: Every model is equipped with: 1 Saw Blades; 1 Sawn-off Shotgun; 1 Squig Launchas.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise
abilities.description: DEADLY DEMISE24.08From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat. This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").
abilities.legend: From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.description: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can: Re-roll advance rolls. Become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: That unit has 5+ InSv. That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.

abilities.name: Squig Barrage
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) hit by this unit’s Squig Launchas weapons. That enemy unit is covered in Squigs until the start of your next turn: While a unit is covered in Squigs, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units). TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: MOW 'EM DOWN
stratagems.legend: Spiked rams, deff rollas and glyph-heavy dozer blades are more than just stylish statements for the crew of Ork vehicles.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Orks Vehicle unit (excluding Walker units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have: [Cleave 1]. Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

stratagems.name: FUNGUS-FUEL INJECTION
stratagems.legend: Fermented through entirely unstable processes, just a drop of these potent additives can supercharge any Mek-built engine.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Orks mounted/vehicle unit is selected to move. TARGET: That ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit has +2" M.

stratagems.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
stratagems.legend: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Speed Freeks unit. TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.

stratagems.name: DAKKASTORM
stratagems.legend: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: DELICIOUS EATING SQUIGS
stratagems.legend: Besides more dangerous fare, Squig-lobbing buggies fire edible Squigs for a price, guaranteed to enliven any Ork if he can eat it before it eats him.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies unit. EFFECT: Select any number of friendly Orks Infantry units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz
enhancements.legend: These loud, fume-belching devices wreathe those in the Speed Freeks’ wake in a thick bank of obscuring smoke.
enhancements.description: Speed Freeks unit only (excluding Aircraft units). When an attack targets a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of a model in this unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

detachmentAbilities.name: Adrenaline Junkies
detachmentAbilities.legend: After smashing into the foe at full tilt, a Speed Freek will pull hairpin turns to do it all again.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly Warbikers units have BATTLELINE. When a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move: That unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault] until the end of the turn. That move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

detachmentAbilities.name: Get Stuck In
detachmentAbilities.legend: Joyously anarchic and recklessly destructive, all Orks eagerly get stuck in to every fight.
detachmentAbilities.description: Friendly ORKS units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

detachments.name: War Horde
detachments.legend: RIOTOUS MULTITUDES OF ORKS AND RAMSHACKLE VEHICLES HIT THE FOE WITH DISORDERED BRUTALITY

detachments.name: Da Big Hunt
detachments.legend: THE GROUND TREMBLES WHEN STAMPEDING BEAST SNAGGAS CONVERGE ON THEIR PREY

detachments.name: Kult of Speed
detachments.legend: SPEED-ADDLED LOONS HURTLE INTO BATTLE IN AN EXHAUST-CHOKED DEATH RACE

detachments.name: Dread Mob
detachments.legend: RAMSHACKLE WALKERS STOMP INTO THE FOE IN A CLANKING KNOT OF GUNS AND KLAWS

detachments.name: Green Tide
detachments.legend: BELLOWING ORK INFANTRY IN UNRULY MOBS HIT LIKE AN AVALANCHE OF MUSCLE

detachments.name: Bully Boyz
detachments.legend: WITH HUGE MUSCLES, WEAPONS AND EGOS, ORKISH VETERANS CAN KRUMP ANYONE

detachments.name: Ramship Raiders
detachments.legend: When Ork void fleets attack enemy shipping, they often lead the assault with ramships. These pugnacious craft slam headlong into the foes’ vessels, burying themselves in the superstructure of larger enemy ships before filling them with rampaging Ork boarders.

detachments.name: Kaptin Killers
detachments.legend: Regardless of the wider objectives of a void war, once a Warboss and his best Boyz get aboard an enemy ship their top priority is nearly always finding the enemy shipmaster and beating them to a pulp. If that leads to capturing the vessel in the process, so much the better!

detachments.name: Taktikal Brigade
detachments.legend: BACKSTABBERS AND ROKKITEERS SPRING DUBIOUS BUT VIOLENTLY EFFECTIVE STRATEGIES

detachments.name: Blitz Brigade
detachments.legend: IN A THUNDERING MASS, HEAVILY ARMED TANKS AND RIGS PLOUGH TOWARDS THE FOE

detachments.name: Wreckas
detachments.legend: DESTRUCTIVE LOOT-GRABBAS DESCEND ON PRIZED TARGETS WITH VICIOUS GRINS

detachments.name: Runt Swarm
detachments.legend: SNEAKY AND GITTISH GRETCHIN ARE SURPRISINGLY EFFECTIVE IN LARGE NUMBERS

detachments.name: Shoota Boyz
detachments.legend: DAKKA-ADDICTS GLEEFULLY UNLEASH EAR-SPLITTING FUSILADES OF FIREPOWER

detachments.name: Madcap Meks
detachments.legend: TECH-SAVVY TINKERERS UNLEASH INSANE CONTRAPTIONS AND ANARCHIC GUBBINZ

detachments.name: Brute Bosses
detachments.legend: BELLIGERENT GENERALS AND LIVING EMBODIMENTS OF ORKDOM LEAD THE RAMPAGE

detachments.name: Flyboyz
detachments.legend: TRIGGER-HAPPY ORK PILOTS ATTACK FROM THE SKIES IN BLITZING AERIAL ASSAULTS

detachments.name: Wurrband
detachments.legend: WEIRDBOYZ VENT SUPERNATURAL ENERGIES IN A STORM OF PRIMITIVE WAAAGH! POWER

enhancements.name: Wimp-kickaz
enhancements.legend: Any snivelling gitz attempting to back away from a good fight with these arrogant Nobz get a good kicking to see them on their way.
enhancements.description: Nobz unit only. When an enemy unit engaged with this unit is selected to make a fall-back move: That enemy unit must select the desperate escape mode. If this unit is riled up, that enemy unit has -1 to the hazard rolls made for that desperate escape.

enhancements.name: Da Krunch
enhancements.legend: Roiling energies frequently erupt from this Weirdboy’s eyes, solidifying above the enemy into the huge green foot of Gork (or Mork) himself, which repeatedly stamps on the foe.
enhancements.description: Orks Psyker model only. This model has the following weapon.

enhancements.name: Supa-glowy Fing
enhancements.legend: The Mek who cobbled together this strange dakka accelerator isn’t sure exactly what it does - and it glows weirdly - but its new owner proudly carries it to battle, eager to know what its big switch will do this time.
enhancements.description: Orks Infantry model only (excluding Weirdboy models). This model’s ranged attacks have: [Anti-Infantry 4+]. [Devastating Wounds]. [SUPA-HAZARDOUS]. [SUPA-HAZARDOUS]: Each time a unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make two hazard rolls for that unit for each [SUPA-HAZARDOUS] weapon you selected in the Select Weapons step.

enhancements.name: Tellyporta
enhancements.legend: Employing madcap tellyporta arrays, Ork Meks can beam massively armoured Nobz through the warp and onto an enemy vessel, much to the horror of the defenders.
enhancements.description: In the Deploy Armies step, select one MEGANObz unit from your army. Until the end of the battle, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

enhancements.name: Extra Sneaky
enhancements.legend: A lifetime of evading the attentions of Orks and even other runts has honed these Grots’ sneakiness to preternatural levels.
enhancements.description: Gretchin unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Kaptin's Hat
enhancements.legend: This impressively ostentatious piece of headgear signifies that whoever nicked it last controls a fleet of kroozers and invasion landers, ideal for the rapid redeployment of loot-hungry Orks.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/Warboss Infantry model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Orks Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
enhancements.legend: With a lifetime of picking fights with the galaxy’s most lethal fighters behind him, and a gnarled hide thicker than Battlewagon armour, this Ork has survived blows that would fell an Ambull.
enhancements.description: Infantry Warboss model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6: On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Flyboss
enhancements.legend: Brutish aces who have survived enough dogfights to rise to positions of superiority, Flybosses inspire other Ork aviators to heights of psychotic enthusiasm.
enhancements.description: Orks Aircraft unit only. This unit has CHARACTER. When this unit ends an ingress move, each friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit within 6" of this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Glory Hog
enhancements.legend: When bigger prey is sighted, nothing can keep this hunter from it. With a roar of glee, lesser gitz are swiftly forgotten in his enthusiasm to pile into a greater challenge.
enhancements.description: Beast Snagga model only. When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Headwoppa's Killchoppa
enhancements.legend: Tribal legend speaks of a blood-slick choppa once owned by Grand Warboss Headwoppa - last seen charging headlong into a horde of daemons - that turns up occasionally across the galaxy in different forms. Though it looks normal, a dark voice is said to growl in the mind of the weapon’s wielder, driving them on to ever greater excesses of violence.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model’s melee attacks have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Cybork Boosta
enhancements.legend: This Mek’s extra bioniks help him keep up with his Kans.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/Mek model only. This model has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind
enhancements.legend: This Big Mek’s obsession with feverish inventing and his dreams of ludicrous technological destruction are infectious, inspiring other Orks to excitable aggression.
enhancements.description: Big Mek model only. This unit is riled up.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Gizmos
enhancements.legend: These sparkly optiks and other elaborate gitfindas help focus a wagon’s dakka, but it takes a really clever Mek to know how to work them.
enhancements.description: Wagon unit only. While a Big Mek model is embarked within this unit: This unit’s ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover]. If this unit is riled up, this unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Living Battering Ram
enhancements.legend: There is something uniquely terrifying to the foe about a nine-foot-tall, four-hundred-pound Ork who prefers to open hatchways with their head while running full tilt and bellowing like a battle tank.
enhancements.description: Each time the bearer attempts to operate a closed Hatchway, your opponent cannot try to prevent it. In addition, each time the bearer opens a Hatchway, each enemy unit within 6" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Kill Kommanda
enhancements.legend: Possessed of exceptional kunnin’ and a weird obsession with sneakin’ about, this powerful Ork leader loves nothing more than creeping through enemy defences before carving a bloody path through their lines.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/Warboss Infantry model only. While this model is part of an attached unit, this model has: Infiltrators. Stealth.

enhancements.name: Ferocious Show-off
enhancements.legend: This brutal fighter is even more dangerous with a raucous audience of chanting Orks, as he displays his violent abilities as a warning to all.
enhancements.description: Orks Infantry model only. This model’s melee attacks have: +1 A. Or: If this unit has 11+ models, +2 A.

enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz
enhancements.legend: These loud, fume-belching devices wreathe those in the Speed Freeks’ wake in a thick bank of obscuring smoke.
enhancements.description: Speed Freeks unit only (excluding Aircraft units). When an attack targets a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of a model in this unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Minefield Detail
enhancements.legend: Rebellious, lazy or just plain unlucky Gretchin are driven into dangerous vanguard duties. These runts scarper forward with the hope of making it through as quickly as possible.
enhancements.description: Gretchin unit only. While this unit is not embarked, this unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Tellyporta Boss
enhancements.legend: This Ork has bullied his way into possession of a mostly functional tellyporta pad, and has so far survived being thrown through the Warp towards the best fights.
enhancements.description: Mega Armour model only. This unit (excluding Vehicle units) has Deep Strike.

enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon
enhancements.legend: Despite claims of scoutin’, this aircraft’s screaming dive ahead of its pilot’s mates is purely for the thrill of attacking first.
enhancements.description: Orks Aircraft unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: 'Eadbanger
enhancements.legend: Known for yelling ‘Kop dis, ya zogger!’ at his chosen target beforehand, this Weirdboy is in the habit of projecting a bolt of raw power from his forehead which splatters the victim’s brains across a wide area.
enhancements.description: Orks Psyker model only. This model has the following weapon.

enhancements.name: Boss Boomer
enhancements.legend: Fitted with speakin’ tubes linked to deafening projectors, this noisy ride allows an important Ork to boss his ladz around while on the move.
enhancements.description: Wagon unit only. While a Warboss model is embarked within this unit, this unit has that WARBOSS model’s Intimidating Motivation/Keep Huntin’ ability.

enhancements.name: It Came from da Drops
enhancements.legend: The monstrous resilience - and odour - of this Beastboss’ hulking mount has inspired many lurid tales of its origin.
enhancements.description: Beastboss on Squigosaur model only. This model has +1 T.

enhancements.name: 'Ardboyz
enhancements.legend: Orks with enough teef - or muscle - can acquire extra scrap iron plates collectively referred to as ‘eavy armour, which is battered into shape so that it roughly fits the wearer.
enhancements.description: Boyz unit only. This unit has 4+ Sv.

enhancements.name: Temperamental Shokka
enhancements.legend: Shokk attack guns are notoriously unreliable, and even with a supposedly enhanced set of worky bits, this Big Mek is never certain what will happen when he sets the thing off.
enhancements.description: Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun model only. In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can roll one D6: On a 1, this model’s Shokk Attack Gun weapon has [Torrent], and when this unit has shot, this model is destroyed. On a 2-5, this model’s Shokk Attack Gun weapon has +1 A. On a 6, this model’s Shokk Attack Gun weapon has [Sustained Hits 2].

enhancements.name: Supa-snazz Dakka
enhancements.legend: Coils of sparking wires, unstable propellant and throbbing power cells are just some of the extras which Flash Gitz rivet onto their snazzguns to kill the enemy in more over-the-top ways.
enhancements.description: Flash Gitz unit only. This unit’s Snazzgun weapons have [Rapid Fire 1].

enhancements.name: Gnasher Squig Crates
enhancements.legend: This Warboss has ordered his ladz to bring armoured crates of vicious gnasher squigs aboard. Upended into strategically vital areas, they create a dangerous infestation that enemies will struggle to remove.
enhancements.description: WARbOSS model only. In your Command phase, you can select one NObz or MEGANObz unit from your army (excluding Battle-shocked units) that is within 6" of the bearer and is within range of an objective marker. If there are no enemy models within range of that objective marker, it is Secured by your army.

enhancements.name: Throat-slittas
enhancements.legend: Veterans of the relatively organised butchery of well-protected targets, these distrusted Orks make excellent forward assassins.
enhancements.description: Kommandos/Stormboyz unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

enhancements.name: Scarred Brute
enhancements.legend: A veteran of many boarding actions, this monstrous Ork has been shot, stabbed and ejected into hard vacuum many times, and has all the toughened scarring and bionik wotnots to show for it.
enhancements.description: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Dreadherder
enhancements.legend: This Mek is deft at avoiding his creations’ feet and klaws.
enhancements.description: Big Mek model only. While this model is within 3" of a friendly Orks Walker unit (excluding BIG MEK units): This model has Lone Operative. In your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly ORKS WALKER unit within 3" of this model. That unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs
enhancements.legend: With a couple of these boggle-eyed varieties of Squigs on hand, even Ork shooting has a chance of hitting distant targets, helped by squinting really hard.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/bigBoss/Warboss model only. This unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Torrent] attacks) have +3" R.

enhancements.name: Competitive Streak
enhancements.legend: This Speedboss despises the thought of coming anything less than first in a race to reach the biggest fights.
enhancements.description: Deffkilla Wartrike model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Da Boss is Watchin'
enhancements.legend: This war leader is a glowering incarnation of violence, his brutality so contagious that when he bellows his blind fury and releases his pent-up aggression, Orks nearby are excitedly swept along with him.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Movement phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Brutal But Kunnin'
enhancements.legend: What tactics occasionally pop into this Ork’s head revolve purely around how hard he needs to wallop his enemies to send their skulls flying.
enhancements.description: Warboss model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 D.

enhancements.name: Kunnin' But Brutal
enhancements.legend: Feigning weakness, this Ork allows his foes to think he’s legging it before suddenly piling back into the fight and delivering a brutal flurry of attacks.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Runt-maw
enhancements.legend: These kustom jobs incorporate an oversized suction device, drawing in nearby runts aplenty, as well as Squigs, loose scrap, and even poorly fastened pieces of the gun itself. The Mek’s targets - those that survive - end up infested with countless screeching Snotlings.
enhancements.description: Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun model only. When this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is infested with Snotlings until the start of your next turn. While an enemy unit is infested with Snotlings, that unit has -1 to leadership rolls.

enhancements.name: Blitzboss
enhancements.legend: It is said this Ork bleeds Squig oil and his growl is that of a revving engine. Certainly any vehicle he rides to war seems to respond powerfully to his presence.
enhancements.description: Warboss model only. A transport unit (excluding Walker units) this unit is embarked within has: +2" M. 5+ InSv.

enhancements.name: Warphead
enhancements.legend: Where most Weirdboyz would quite like to be left alone, so-called Warpheads become addicted to the danger, intentionally supercharging their tortured minds and revelling in venting dangerously unpredictable powers.
enhancements.description: Orks Psyker model only. This model: Has psyker level 2. Has Deadly Demise D6. Can re-roll psychic rolls.

enhancements.name: Follow Me Ladz
enhancements.legend: Always found at the forefront of an assault, this Ork likes to be the first into the fray with his mob close on his heels to join in the violence.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. This unit has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Proper Killy
enhancements.legend: This unstoppable brute is an engine of destruction whose welts of scars have been won in countless victories.
enhancements.description: Warboss model only. This model can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Morgog's Finkin' Cap
enhancements.legend: Thanks to the tangle of stolen empyric electrodes wired into this helmet, a powerful Ork wearing it is capable of thinking a little further ahead than his next fight.
enhancements.description: Warboss model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent’s Movement phase, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". If this unit is riled up, you can re-roll that D6.

enhancements.name: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss
enhancements.legend: Firing gold-plated teef as its unconventional ammunition, da Gobshot Thunderbuss proclaims its owner’s obscene wealth even as it sweeps away swathes of enemies.
enhancements.description: Warboss model only. This model has the following weapon:

stratagems.name: READIED BRAWLERS
stratagems.legend: Bursting from assault hatches, pounding down boarding ramps or leaping from handholds, this thuggish transport’s fighters are quick to pile out.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Wagon unit ends a normal move. TARGET: That WAGON unit. EFFECT: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.

stratagems.name: IMPENDING KRUNCH
stratagems.legend: Having several tons of metal covered in blood, rust and spikes bearing down on them can shake the resolve of the most stoic warriors.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Wagon unit ends a charge move. TARGET: That WAGON unit. EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
stratagems.legend: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within. EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: HULKING BRUTES
stratagems.legend: The thick armour and thicker skulls of Nobz make them a daunting prospect to gun down.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Meganobz/Nobz unit. TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls. +1CPOr: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: TOO ARROGANT TO DIE
stratagems.legend: With bone-headed arrogance, Nobz will carry on killing before their deaths finally dawn on them.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Meganobz/Nobz unit. TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: ARMED TO DA TEEF
stratagems.legend: Nobz load themselves with all manner of weapons in shows of wealth and influence.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Meganobz/Nobz unit is selected to attack. TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can: Re-roll hit rolls of 1. If your unit is riled up, re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.name: GOADED INTO ACTION
stratagems.legend: Should attempts to obliterate the Beast Snaggas from afar fail, it is often the foe’s last mistake as the hunters turn their baleful attention on them.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Beast Snagga unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks. EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.

stratagems.name: INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS
stratagems.legend: With a keen eye for tracking their prey, Beast Snaggas will circle around to ambush the luckless gitz from another angle.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Beast Snagga unit within 6" of a battlefield edge. EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: WHERE D'YA FINK YOU'RE GOING?
stratagems.legend: Beast Snagga victims often make a break for it before the Orks have tired of fighting. Hooked, impaled or ridden down, few survive such flight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly Beast Snagga unit. TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA unit. EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, with -1 from those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: CRAZED RAMPAGE
stratagems.legend: Even horrific damage will not prevent many Ork combat walkers from crunching and stomping their enemies in a final fugue of psychotic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Orks Walker unit (excluding Titanic units). TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has Deff Dread: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: STOMPING JUGGERNAUT
stratagems.legend: A pilot’s single-mindedness and his walker’s durable form mean few obstacles can impede its relentless stomping advance.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Orks Walker unit is selected to move or declares a charge. TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit. EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: DREAD POWER
stratagems.legend: Fuelled by the pilot’s obsession or psychosis - and powered up by varied erratic gubbinz - it is little wonder that a Kan’s stomping rampages are constantly reignited.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Orks Walker unit. EFFECT: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

stratagems.name: WHIRLIGIG EVASION
stratagems.legend: Enemy attempts to hunt Deffkoptas down can be stymied by nimble aerial evasion, usually accompanied by a crude hand gesture in the foe’s direction.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Deffkoptas unit within 8" of that enemy unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If your unit is riled up, up to 6".

stratagems.name: FLYIN' HEADBUTT
stratagems.legend: Some Ork pilots, out of bullets and out of luck, brighten up considerably when they realise their own aircraft is a deadly weapon in its own right.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft unit is destroyed, before rolling for any Deadly Demise. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit does not have the Deadly Demise ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6: For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Then remove your unit from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: LONG, UNCONTROLLED BURSTS
stratagems.legend: Ork Flyboyz will fill the skies with dakka in an attempt to down any enemy they think is muscling in on their aerial turf.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit. EFFECT: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.name: UNBRIDLED CARNAGE
stratagems.legend: When da Boyz get stuck into the foe, the carnage is wonderful to behold, at least for all their mates.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Boyz unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight. TARGET: That BOYZ unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.

stratagems.name: 'ERE WE GO
stratagems.legend: Orks can put on a surprising turn of speed when the promise of a good face-to-face fight is in the offing.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Beast Snagga Boyz/Boyz unit is selected to move. TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit. EFFECT: Your unit has +2 to advance rolls.

stratagems.name: MOB MENTALITY
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models. EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: CORNERED AND KRUMPED
stratagems.legend: It is no easy thing to disentangle from a mob of ferocious Orks and retreat in good order, especially when cornered by them within the claustrophobic confines of a voidship.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back. TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. EFFECT: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.

stratagems.name: PIT FIGHTER
stratagems.legend: This Warboss is a terror of the fighting pits, single-mindedly battering his way through lesser foes or simply sweeping them aside as he carves a path towards his true quarry.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Charge phase. TARGET: One WARBOSS model from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: LOOT ON THE MOVE
stratagems.legend: Not only does ripping a door hatch right off its hinges allow for ease of progress, but the resultant large slab of bulletproof metal can make a handy temporary shield.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: DELICIOUS EATING SQUIGS
stratagems.legend: Besides more dangerous fare, Squig-lobbing buggies fire edible Squigs for a price, guaranteed to enliven any Ork if he can eat it before it eats him.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies unit. EFFECT: Select any number of friendly Orks Infantry units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.

stratagems.name: DAKKASTORM
stratagems.legend: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
stratagems.legend: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Speed Freeks unit. TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit. EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.

stratagems.name: VINDICTIVE ARTILLERISTS
stratagems.legend: Though cowardly, Grot artillery crews will dare to overcharge their weapons in acts of spectacular spite.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Mek Gunz unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That MEK GUNZ unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Lethal Hits]. Or: [Sustained Hits 1]. Or: [Hazardous], [Lethal Hits], [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: RAMBOYZ RAMPAGE
stratagems.legend: These ramship-riding Orks emulate the actions of their warship by barrelling full-tilt towards the enemy while roaring like lunatics then crashing into them head-on.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase. TARGET: One BOYz unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced and each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: EAGER TO FIGHT
stratagems.legend: Impatient from being bottled up aboard their voidships with no one to clobber, this mob cannot wait to get stuck in to a proper scrap.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make an Advance move.

stratagems.name: ENRAGED RUSH
stratagems.legend: Shooting this mob only serves to attract their attention while simultaneously making them angry at such a blatant attempt to deny them a good punch up.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot. TARGET: One BOYz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. EFFECT: Your unit can make an Enraged Rush move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: PILE THROUGH
stratagems.legend: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: SCARPER!
stratagems.legend: Through natural cowardice or a Runtherd’s threats, Grots’ agile reactions can leave foes flat-footed.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Gretchin unit. TARGET: That GRETCHIN unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: Up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.

stratagems.name: INFESTED WAR ZONE
stratagems.legend: Short, scrawny and skilled at hiding, there are usually a lot more Gretchin about than meets the eye.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked. TARGET: One friendly Gretchin unit that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though that unit was just destroyed. EFFECT: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in strategic reserves, at its starting strength, with its full wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: GROT SHIELDS
stratagems.legend: Despite their protestations, Gretchin make surprisingly effective bullet shields.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Orks Infantry unit (excluding Gretchin units). TARGET: One friendly Gretchin unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: When a hit roll for that enemy unit’s ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: NEVER ENOUGH DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: KUSTOM DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: WHILE THEIR BACKS ARE TURNED
stratagems.legend: With the gitz they were fighting having scarpered, mobs with a plan exploit the sudden lull to press towards whatever target has next caught their eye.
stratagems.description: WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit that was engaged at the start of the phase. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: MIND MOSTLY ON THE MISSION
stratagems.legend: When there’s a dirty job needs doing, Orks with strange compulsions get a kick out of causing such trouble sneakily or swiftly.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move. TARGET: That BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit. EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: DUBIOUS RESTRAINT
stratagems.legend: A few Orks, particularly those of a rebelliously disciplined outlook, can resist their destructive urges just long enough to prioritise strategic gains.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Start/end of your Movement phase. TARGET: One friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit. EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: MOW 'EM DOWN
stratagems.legend: Spiked rams, deff rollas and glyph-heavy dozer blades are more than just stylish statements for the crew of Ork vehicles.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Orks Vehicle unit (excluding Walker units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have: [Cleave 1]. Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

stratagems.name: FUNGUS-FUEL INJECTION
stratagems.legend: Fermented through entirely unstable processes, just a drop of these potent additives can supercharge any Mek-built engine.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Orks mounted/vehicle unit is selected to move. TARGET: That ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Your unit has +2" M.

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight. TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units). TARGET: That ORKS unit. EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
stratagems.legend: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked. TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked. EFFECT: Roll one D3: Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result. Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: DRIVE-BY BUSTIN'
stratagems.legend: Ork transports are not the smoothest of rides. However, the best loot-hunters have honed their drive-by volleys of armour-cracking firepower to the point of deadly accuracy.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Transport unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That ORKS TRANSPORT unit. EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: GRAB IT
stratagems.legend: Wreckin’ some gitz is all well and good, but getting the drop on them and then grabbing an opportunity for some loot is even better.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged Breaka Boyz/Flash Gitz/Tankbustas unit has shot. TARGET: That BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit. EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an objective. Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: GUN-CRAZY SHOW-OFFS
stratagems.legend: With a snort of contempt, these Orks decide to show the gitz who just shot at them what real guns are capable of.
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot. TARGET: One friendly Flash Gitz/Tankbustas unit hit by those attacks. EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Waaagh!
abilities.legend: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.
abilities.description: Friendly ORKS units with this ability can: Re-roll advance rolls. Become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up: That unit has 5+ InSv. That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. War Cry (Once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.

abilities.name: Da Boss
abilities.legend: Whether capable of kunnin’ strategy or favouring something far less complicated, the biggest Ork tends to have a voice as aggressive and brutal as the rest of him. His bellows can be heard over the thickest fighting and his reputation ensures the ladz do as they’re told.
abilities.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Unstable Energies
abilities.legend: Ork psykers – Weirdboyz and their unsavoury ilk – release the painful build-up of Waaagh! energy in sudden discharges of power, usually with spectacularly lethal results.
abilities.description: Orks Psyker units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name. In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level. Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.
